html:
The Kaantju are an Aboriginal Australian people of central Cape York Peninsula in north Queensland, in the area around today's town of Coen.

Their neighbours were the Uutaalnganu and Kuuku Ya'u toward the east coast, the Lama Lama to the south and the Wik peoples to the west. Small goldfields around Coen opened in the late 1800s, and most Kaantju land was taken for cattle stations. Many Kaantju people still live around Coen.
sum: The Kaantju are an Aboriginal Australian people of central Cape York Peninsula in north Queensland, in the area around today's town of Coen.
